cards.title: Strands BPE (track 1)
cards.notes: KILLER-FEATURE VERDICT: MAYBE, leaning NO for coding. Untrained BPE is FLAT on SWE-bench Pro (clean rev2: Sonnet5 +0.7pp p=1.0, Sonnet4.5 -1.4pp, Haiku +5pp p=0.09); strong on ALFWorld. Trained multi-turn could still flip it but is BLOCKED on GPU capacity (p4de InsufficientInstanceCapacity). Caveat: only multi-turn traces on hand are ALFWorld, not SWE. Evoharness pushed to GitFarm (StanEvoharness mainline).

cards.title: (a) Validate latest results table
cards.notes: DONE. Independent validation found the table fnp saw was the CONTAMINATED rev1 round (disk-full artifacts faked +14.3pp win and -11.4pp harm). Clean rev2 shows BPE flat on coding. rev1 retracted, rev2 authoritative.

cards.title: (b) LoRA-SFT training go/no-go
cards.notes: GO given by fnp. Single-turn SFT done (Qwen3-8B 0.7/0.0 -> 2.1/2.9%, still floored, taught format not execution). Multi-turn NOT run: blocked on GPU capacity.
